What is a good book for a 9 year old?

The Book of Virtues by William J Bennett.

It's loaded with fables and fairy stories and myths. They are divided into sections, one for each virtue. And the stories in those sections correspond to that virtue. He has another one, The Moral Compass. Similar organization, but for slightly older kids, divided into sections for the cardinal directions. The stories reflect more nuanced moral lessons.

I messed up the title. I wanted to ask what is a good dictionary for a 9 year old.

My kids used an illustrarated dictionary published by Dempsy Parr.

http://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/2000-hb-dempsey-parr-childrens-778581014

We also had another, much larger and heavier illustrated dictionary that saw a lot of use. Can't find it to get the publisher. We moved and not all boxes of books were unpacked. It was great, but too heavy for my midgets to pick up and carry around. That's why I bought a copy of the cheaper Dempsy Parr dictionary. I think it was $10, while the larger was closer to $50.

My suggestion is that you look for one with a lot of color illustrations. They really do encourage kids to keep reading entries. I used to get lost in dictionaries looking at all the drawings.

Make sure you avoid any First dictionaries. They will be geared towards younger children.
